risk.summary: Inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (194.7) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings binary event in 6 days creates compounded downside risk for WY.

debate.key_bull_argument: Recent MACD, TEMA, and Force Index crossovers up provide short-term momentum signals with price near support at 27.27, offering defined risk entry for tactical swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings event in 6 days combined with VIX crisis levels (194.7), inverted yield curve, overbought oscillators (StochRSI, Williams %R), price below 50/200 SMAs, and zero fundamental/sentiment conviction create compounded binary and macro downside risk that overwhelms technical crossover signals.
